description: Seed or review a public JSON OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 contract against its saved baseline/latest observation; return directional compatibility/security findings and explicit uncertainty. No YAML, external-ref crawling or runtime compatibility proof. One fixed workflow charge; internal steps never create separate customer charges. First source use seeds state in this same operation; later observations use returned owned observation_id. Auth: authorized native-USDC x402 v2 on Base, enabled MPP, or an eligible prepaid key plus exact tariff 5 and max_credits. Ordinary unpaid calls return a challenge, not execution. Persist original input, proof and recovery token before submission; exact replay returns retained results without fresh work or another charge. Choose evidence detail before authorization. No free-trial or automatic paid fallback. 0.010 USDC or 4 credits. Limits and scope are authoritative, not a complete audit or compatibility guarantee. The same fixed x402 service price may also be paid in native Circle USDC on Solana Mainnet (solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp), when advertised by the unpaid challenge. Explicitly select one accepted network and pin its mint, merchant, amount and sponsored fee payer before signing. Solana payers need no Base wallet; MPP remains Base-only. Payment network does not change the observed chain: blockchain products still inspect finalized Base. Solana delivery requires finalized matching USDC evidence. Persist the original network, resource, input, proof and private recovery capability; never switch networks or authorize a replacement after uncertainty.

compare_to.description: Default previous compares with the latest successful workflow observation; baseline compares with its original seed. Seeding is one paid workflow operation and reports no comparison, never a second internal charge.

detail.description: Default compact: at most 20 evidence items per section. Expanded allows at most 200 document findings or 100 Base events and retains raw validated logs/getter ABI details within the same fixed work/output ceiling. Counts and omitted-evidence warnings remain explicit.

observation_id.description: Owned observation_id returned by this same workflow. Reuses its immutable source/scope and saved baseline/latest observations; not a primitive watch_id. Seven-day state retention. Missing, foreign or expired IDs never silently rebaseline.

url.description: Public HTTPS source for a new or existing canonical source/scope identity. Supply exactly one of url or observation_id. A new identity seeds once; the next operation compares.
